theme: An open day in Maine, the girls down south
greeting: A wide-open Friday, Dan — the girls are with Jen this stretch and you're up in Portland. Just a haircut on the books today, the Black Keys at the State tomorrow at noon, and a Mike + Dan board that's overdue for a push.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week has been sitting on the board since Sept 14. Holiday inventory there sells out — a refundable hold booked now removes the whole risk and the dates can flex later.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Decide-by was Sept 30 and book-by is Oct 15, five days out. The note points at a domestic shortlist for all four kids over Dec 13–Jan 2, since passports won't be in hand by the booking date.

needsAttention.title: Set the Pathfinder drive dates
needsAttention.detail: You're mid-window for the Portland to St Pete drive (Oct 5–18). Picking the two or three days and booking the one hotel night gets the car south before the school-year cycle resumes.
